statement: For every positive alpha,beta the interleaved base-2 floor sequences form a Sigma-sequence; if alpha/beta is irrational, then for every fixed modulus q some finite prefix has subset sums covering all residues modulo q.
closes: every fixed-modulus obstruction in the base-2 problem
dependency_gaps: Fixed-modulus coverage has no quantitative prefix bound uniform in q.
A lift from modular representatives to arbitrarily long consecutive integer subset sums is missing.
The nonintegral gamma variant lacks the one-bit recurrence.
